outcome: Microvillous membrane (MVM) system A amino acid transporter activity
Microvillous membrane (MVM) system L amino acid transporter activity
cohort: The study participants were healthy pregnant women residing at either high altitude (>2,500 m; n = 14) or low altitude (<1,700 m; n = 14) who delivered via planned, unlabored cesarean section.
finding: Despite lower birth weights in neonates born at high altitude, there was no effect of altitude on microvillous membrane system A or L amino acid transporter activity, suggesting impaired placental amino acid transport does not contribute to reduced birth weight in this population.
birth_weight: HA pregnancies: 2.88 ± 0.11 kg; LA pregnancies: 3.30 ± 0.07 kg
